Through this engagement, we will scale engineering and technology operations to support ERP modernization, cloud-native platforms, and AI capabilities for our client. …
After decades of advancement in the computer industry, we are now at the beginnings of a new industrial revolution
To be part of this AI economy, you don’t want to just be consuming the AI; you want to be producing the AI … We could do all of that here in Europe, and in fact, we’ve already started.
